commitments.quote: Frequent Network bus routes provide service every 10 minutes or better between 6 a.m. and 9 p.m. on weekdays and 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekends.
commitments.metric: share of Frequent Network route-direction-hours inside the service windows scheduled at 10 minutes or better
commitments.measured: CTA GTFS timetable: scheduled trips per route, direction, day type and hour (6 or more trips = 10 min or better)
commitments.measured_from: data/transit/service.json (GTFS extract, data/sources.toml gtfs_cta); routes and join dates data/frequent_network.toml

commitments.quote: Frequent Network bus routes provide service every 10 minutes or better between 6 a.m. and 9 p.m. on weekdays and 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekends.
commitments.metric: share of eligible Frequent Network route-direction-hours whose delivered headway (from polled positions) is 10 minutes or better
commitments.measured: CTA Bus Tracker positions polled about every 5 minutes, headways at the route's midpoint, against the same windows (W2)

commitments.quote: Vision Zero is Chicago's commitment to eliminating death and serious injury from traffic crashes by 2026.
commitments.measured: count of Vision Zero fatality records with crash_date in 2026
commitments.measured_from: City of Chicago data portal gzaz-isa6 (Vision Zero Chicago Traffic Fatalities), aggregate count
commitments.source_title: Vision Zero Chicago Action Plan 2017-2019 (published June 2017), PDF page 7

commitments.quote: Vision Zero is Chicago's commitment to eliminating death and serious injury from traffic crashes by 2026.
commitments.metric: people seriously (incapacitating) injured in traffic crashes in 2026
commitments.measured: sum of injuries_incapacitating over crash records with crash_date in 2026
commitments.measured_from: City of Chicago data portal 85ca-t3if (Traffic Crashes - Crashes), aggregate sum
commitments.source_title: Vision Zero Chicago Action Plan 2017-2019 (published June 2017), PDF page 7

commitments.quote: Reduce deaths from traffic crashes 20% citywide by 2020.
commitments.metric: traffic deaths in 2020 vs a baseline
commitments.measured: count of Vision Zero fatality records; the plan states no baseline year
commitments.measured_from: City of Chicago data portal gzaz-isa6
commitments.source_title: Vision Zero Chicago Action Plan 2017-2019, Action Plan Benchmarks, PDF pages 7 and 20
commitments.reason: the source states no baseline year; none is chosen here

commitments.quote: Reduce serious injuries from traffic crashes 35% by 2020.
commitments.metric: serious injuries in 2020 vs a baseline
commitments.measured: sum of injuries_incapacitating; the plan states no baseline year
commitments.source_title: Vision Zero Chicago Action Plan 2017-2019, Action Plan Benchmarks, PDF pages 7 and 20
commitments.reason: the source states no baseline year; none is chosen here

commitments.quote: By 2020, Chicago will: Reduce severe crashes in High Crash Areas and High Crash Corridors by 40%.
commitments.metric: severe crashes in the plan's High Crash Areas and Corridors, 2020 vs a baseline
commitments.measured: needs the High Crash Area and Corridor boundaries and a baseline year
commitments.source_title: Vision Zero Chicago Action Plan 2017-2019, Goal 1, PDF page 27
commitments.reason: needs data not in this repository: High Crash Area and High Crash Corridor boundaries (not mirrored); the plan states no baseline year

commitments.quote: By 2020, Chicago will: Reduce traffic crash fatalities for people living in high economic hardship communities by 25%.
commitments.metric: deaths of residents of high economic hardship communities, 2020 vs a baseline
commitments.measured: needs each victim's home community, which the public fatality data do not contain
commitments.source_title: Vision Zero Chicago Action Plan 2017-2019, Goal 1, PDF page 27
commitments.reason: needs data not in this repository: victims' home community (not in the public data); hardship classification; a baseline year
